title: The First Coffee — EN/ES/FR (Chas McIvor)
style: jazz lounge piano bar dry wit spoken word observational 96bpm upright bass brushed snare deadpan baritone male vocal life philosophy Spanish French language learning family morning
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The first coffee of the morning is not a preference — it's a position
On the nature of consciousness and what constitutes transition
From the state of sleep to the state of the functional
The first coffee is the bridge between the two — it's constitutional

[Verse 2 — Spanish, with English translation]
El primer café de la mañana no es una preferencia — es una posición
[The first coffee of the morning is not a preference — it's a position]
Sobre la naturaleza de la conciencia y la transición
[On the nature of consciousness and the transition]
Del estado de sueño al estado funcional del ser
[From the state of sleep to the functional state of being]
El primer café es el puente entre los dos — hay que tener
[The first coffee is the bridge between the two — you must have]

[Chorus — English]
The first coffee knows something I don't know yet
It knows the exact temperature at which the day is set
The first coffee doesn't need context or acknowledgement
It just begins the conversation between me and it
That's my boy

[Bridge — French, with English translation]
Le premier café du matin n'est pas une préférence — c'est une position
[The first coffee of the morning is not a preference — it's a position]
Sur la nature de la conscience et la transition
[On the nature of consciousness and the transition]
De l'état de sommeil à l'état fonctionnel du lendemain
[From the state of sleep to the functional state of the next day]
Le premier café est le pont entre les deux — c'est le matin
[The first coffee is the bridge between the two — it's morning]

[Outro — All three languages]
The first coffee knows… El primer café sabe… Le premier café sait
The day hasn't started until it starts it — El día no ha empezado hasta que él lo comienza — La journée n'a pas commencé jusqu'à ce qu'il la commence
That's my boy
